name: Alhambra
heritage: bien de interés cultural; Historic Garden (Spain); part of UNESCO World Heritage Site; Zona Patrimonial
type: palace; garden; architectural ensemble; group of monuments
text: The Alhambra (, Spanish: [aˈlambɾa]; Arabic: الْحَمْرَاء, romanized: al-ḥamrāʼ ) is a palace and fortress complex located in Granada, Spain. It is one of the most famous monuments of Islamic architecture and the only well-preserved palace from the medieval Islamic world. Additionally, the palace contains notable examples of Spanish Renaissance architecture.
